title: D: hold ambiguous or incomplete Xero reconciliation replies
public_pr_body:
Existing Xero read-back picked the first matching number and silently converted absent totals to zero. This could report a false match or unsafe absence on retry. The smallest client fix holds ambiguous/incomplete responses, requires numeric totals and identifies sales credits correctly. No connector redesign, migration, credential/configuration or activation changes.

Tests first: 2 passed / 11 failed / 0 skipped; original failure log retained. After fix: 233 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped across 14 mocked suites (16 new tests). TypeScript and targeted ESLint pass. Existing OAuth, mapping, contacts, invoice/credit mapping, retries/idempotency, reconciliation, routes/admin and default disconnected/unconfigured gates reviewed.

All Xero/fetch/DB dependencies mocked; real consent/tenant/DB permissions/live responses and business acceptance remain unproven. Transfers remain off without connection/configuration; existing connected companies must be checked before launch. No live calls, SQL, merge, private files, #359/go-live edits or John messages.
